answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a new challenging translation task called schema translation ... We conduct experiments on our proposed schema translation dataset to evaluate the effectiveness of our approach.
datasets: Parallel schema translation dataset (3,158 tables, 11,979 headers)
answer_1.outputs: Translated column headers in target languages

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performances of different models with the 4-gram BLEU score of the translations.

answer_4.quote: Since the machine evaluation metrics cannot absolutely make sure whether the predicted result is correct or not, we conduct a human evaluation on the test set for a more precise evaluation. Specifically, we invite two experts to evaluate each language pair.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare the machine translation with the human annotation and assign label 1 if the translation is equivalent to the annotation, otherwise 0.
